Opening a new accreditation file. Name the applicant organisation and the scopes it applies for, then press Submit to register it. The reception desk then forwards it to the General Director from the same header. A prerequisites checklist is created from the configured document types when the file is saved, and is verified later by the Certifications Division.

field.name: help
field.p: Register the accreditation file of a demining organisation.

The file walks through the office accreditation (reception, General Director, Legal Department, Certifications Division) and then through the operational accreditation (SOP, fees, dual confirmation, Accreditation Committee, legal refinement, certificate).

field.name: help
field.p: A file appears here the moment it reaches a step your department is responsible for. The My Turn filter understands the parallel dual confirmation: during that step a file sits on the Finance desk and the Operations desk until each of them has signed.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is with the reception desk.
New applications are opened here with New, then submitted and forwarded to the General Director. Files returned by a department for completion also come back to this queue.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is waiting for the initial acceptance.
Files forwarded by the reception desk appear here for the initial acceptance (القبول الأولي). Accept to send the file on to the Legal Department, or return it with a reason.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is waiting for the Legal Department.
Two steps arrive here: the legal review before the prerequisites are checked, and the refinement of the Accreditation Committee decision before the certificate is issued.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is waiting for the Certifications Division.
Files here need their prerequisites checklist (الأوليات) verified: every required document marked provided and accepted. Only then can the office accreditation be granted.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is waiting for the Operations Department.
Operations opens the operational phase, records the paper SOP when it is handed in, and confirms the company SOP for appraisal during the dual confirmation.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is waiting for the Finance Department.
Finance confirms the SOP reading fee and the operational demonstration fee against their receipts, and signs the Finance half of the dual confirmation.

field.name: help
field.p: No file is waiting for the Accreditation Committee.
A file reaches the committee once both fees are settled. Record the decision, the session date and the decision text on the Committee & Decision tab, then confirm it.
